question: Why has Alpaca, alpaca_live above all, taken almost no trades for weeks while markets moved? Correct quiet or fault?

alpaca_live.summary: No fault at any stage. The roster narrowed by operator Tier-3 removals to ONE leg (iaum_pullback_1d) on a long-only cash account with venue shorting disabled. Since 2026-09-28 no long setup fired on any leg rostered there; every routed package was a short and was journalled dry_run_no_order_placed.
alpaca_live.short_signals_routed_and_side_filtered: 7 routed, all journalled dry_run_no_order_placed; 6 of 7 stamp dry_cause side_filter:long; trade 6067 (2026-09-22) carries no dry_cause field (the stamp did not exist yet)
alpaca_live.long_signals_blocked_by_open_package: 4 (SLV 09-21/25/28 while alpaca_live itself held SLV trade 5875; IAUM 09-21 while pkg-5352 was open). Pre-#14565 the open-package gate wrote no audit row, so these read as vanished.
alpaca_live.account_flags: ACTIVE, trading_blocked false, flat, shorting_enabled false (/api/diag/broker_account_status, /api/diag/exchange_positions, read 2026-10-25 ~06:35Z)

alpaca_portfolio.summary: strategies: [] on main and in the running process. Strict mirror equality minus the affordability proxies leaves nothing, because alpaca_live's only leg is the declared proxy iaum_pullback_1d. That consequence was DECIDED 2026-09-21 (B2: equality wins, empty mirror accepted). Its 3 rows in the window are ief_pullback_1d shorts side-filtered before 10-21.

alpaca_paper.summary: 14 legs. 9 closed and 2 open trades since 09-20. Refusals are holds (the leg or a same-symbol leg is already in a position), venue buying power at 0 while large bond shorts held the book, and the GLD zombie OCO (decided keep 2026-10-02), which takes the GLD slot so gld_pullback_1d cannot trade.
alpaca_paper.venue_positions_reconcile: 4/4 venue positions match open journal trades (GDX short 6660, IAUM short 6655, SPY long 4347, GLD long 5209)

Removals in window: tlt_pullback_1h + tlt_pullback_1d (09-21, A6), ief_pullback_1d (10-21), slv_pullback_1d (10-24), all operator Tier-3. It flags 4 alpaca_paper/options legs as starved, each explained: spy_trend_long_1d holds SPY 4347 since 08-03; slv_pullback_1d's entry predates the window (5873, 09-17); gld_pullback_1d is blocked by the GLD wedge (finding F2); alpaca_options_paper slv/gdx come from options_expression no_selection and slv_trend_1h shadow, outside this question.

findings.what: Open-package gate dropped intents with no audit row until #14565 (2026-09-30); 19 leg-days read as vanished, 4 of them on alpaca_live.
findings.disposition: fixed and observed: 10 open_package_blocked leg-days 2026-09-30..10-14, 0 vanished after 09-29. No action.

findings.what: alpaca_paper's GLD 39-sh zombie OCO (venue cancel_accepted_ineffective; stop 416.09 never executed, GLD ~366) was kept by operator decision 2026-10-02 ('Mark it, keep going'). It takes the GLD slot, so rostered gld_pullback_1d is refused on every GLD signal (10-16 flip_suppressed qty=39), and SOAK-MECH-B's close condition for gld_pullback_1d and PAPER-RESET's observation ('zombie OCO cleared') cannot be reached.
findings.disposition: pipeline item, ask_operator via the manager

findings.what: alpaca_paper risk_refused with venue buying_power 0 on 7 packages (09-21..09-24) and near 0 on 10-19/10-20 (gld_pullback_1d), while bond shorts sized 579-876 sh (tlt/ief_pullback_1d) held most of the margin book.

alpaca_live executable flow is about one long a month (1 leg, long-only, cash), and the Gate-2 mirror is empty by decision, so the real-money book now gives neither a mechanics nor a demotion signal at any useful rate.
findings.disposition: pipeline item, ask_operator via the manager (a Tier-3 roster question, not a fix)

findings.what: empty_sizing_map labels an account removed by the per-account open-package gate as outside_account_scope, the same label E35 uses for losing an election.
findings.disposition: not filed: the open_package_scoped audit row keeps the two distinguishable, and nothing decides on the label
